objective.en: Compute commercial PV LCOE quantiles under soft-cost uncertainty
objective.ru: Распределение LCOE коммерческой PV при неопределённости мягких затрат

instructions.en: Use the public executable case inputs to compute the required JSON fields. Do not copy an oracle answer; derive the quantities from the stated calculation_spec.
instructions.ru: Используйте публичные входные данные executable-case для расчёта требуемых JSON-полей. Не копируйте ответ-оракул; выведите величины из calculation_spec.

public_inputs.calculation_spec: For each scenario, capex = system_size_kw * (hard_cost_usd_per_kw + sum(component_cost * scenario_multiplier)). LCOE USD/MWh = (capex*capital_recovery_factor + fixed_om_usd_per_kw_year*system_size_kw) / annual_energy_mwh_year1. Report per-scenario LCOE, p10/p50/p90 empirical quantiles with linear interpolation, and arithmetic mean.

hard_constraints: Structured fields must match the independent calculation from public inputs.
Unknown extra answer keys are infeasible.
